title: Inspections to Proactively Identify Rental Flats that Require Repairs or Maintenance
what_it_is: Inspections to Proactively Identify Rental Flats that Require Repairs or Maintenance

sections.label: HDB rental flat inspections
sections.summary: HDB suspended yearly rental flat inspections during COVID-19 safe management measures and is resuming them, prioritising by flat age and tenant profile.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development whether an update can be provided on the implementation of HDB’s policy on conducting periodic inspections on a yearly basis to proactively identify rental flats which require repairs or maintenance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: However, when COVID-19 safe management measures (SMMs) were imposed, HDB had to suspend this practice and physical inspections were conducted in response to tenants' feedback.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As the SMMs were progressively lifted, HDB has been working to resume periodic inspections and is reviewing the approach to prioritise inspections based on the age of the flat and the profile of tenants.

sections.label: HDB rental flat repairs and upgrading
sections.summary: HDB promptly attends to repair requests, almost always bears repair costs fully, and rental flats undergo upgrading programmes including Project LIFE.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB will attend to these requests promptly and the cost of repairs is almost always borne fully by HDB.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Besides regular maintenance, rental flats undergo upgrading similar to sold flats, as part of programmes, such as the Lift Upgrading Programme and the Home Improvement Programme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In addition, there have been specific enhancement programmes for rental flats, such as the Lift Improvement and Facilities Enhancement for the elderly, called Project LIFE.

sections.label: Tenant repair responsibilities and elderly help
sections.summary: Tenants are responsible for internal walls, fittings, fixtures, doors and gates, while HDB works with community organisations for exceptional cases like elderly tenants.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Nevertheless, those areas, for example, what the Member shared, the gate and also relating to maintenance and repairs of internal walls, fittings, fixtures, including doors and gates, these are where tenants are responsible for.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: What we do for exceptional cases – for example, for elderly tenants – is we will work with community organisations, just like the grassroots organisation in the Member's area, to see how we can partner and work together with them and see how we can help these tenants.
